join_summary.method: point-in-polygon, else nearest polygon within 150 m

metadata.note: This is the only modern per-water-body register Kolkata has, and it is not KMC's - the corporation's own working inventory is a tank list compiled in 1993 plus a 2004 NRSA aerial map. It is deliberately NOT reconciled against the city's other counts (KMC 1,786 in 1997 and 3,873 in 2006; NATMO 8,731 and satellite 4,889, both 2006). Different instruments counting different things is the finding, not an error to average away.
metadata.unmatched_note: 'unmatched' means no OSM water polygon within 150 m of the enumerated point. That is a prompt to look, not proof the body is gone: OSM coverage is partial and census coordinates are enumerator-placed.
